transcript: Nobody does it like Erling Haaland. The guy turns up carrying a Birkin, and the bag is the first thing you notice. If you want a travel bag with that kind of presence, take a look at the Velantra Weekender. It's got a broad rectangular shape, rolled leather handles, and a leather flap over canvas. So even with a plain t-shirt and jeans, it gives you a sharper look. The Cognac version has brown leather against a lighter canvas body with gold tone hardware. Easy to wear with a navy jacket, denim, or a black coat. Inside, there's a wide slip pocket to keep smaller things separate from the main compartment. So you've got a bag for the weekend that looks right when you walk into the hotel too. The Velantra Weekender. Check it out at the link below.
